milestoneContract.title: V6 PKG-R1 sealed release-candidate mode and release packaging tools
milestoneContract.objective: Resolve PKGR-F1 so a correctly sealed release artifact can pass the canonical validation that install.ps1 runs inside the extract, by adding a Founder-approved fail-closed SEALED release-candidate mode to the doc-truth checks, and add the protected release packaging tools (SHA256SUMS generator, deterministic ZIP, fresh-extract verification), without performing the final reseal or claiming any release gate.
requirements: [V6-PKG-R1-RELEASE-MODE-AND-PACKAGING-TOOLS-2026-09-28 founderAuthorization.rule] [PKG-R] Paketleme paketi + reseal yetkisi: yeni protected release-packaging paketi (SHA256SUMS üreticisi, deterministik ZIP, mevcut verify-artifact ile fresh-extract doğrulaması) ve bu paket içinde maintainer-only generate-trust-root.mjs final reseal'ini çalıştırma yetkisi; release imzası Founder'ın harici anahtarında kalır; Codex review otomatik. [Mühürlü mod] paste4d'ye açık ve fail-closed bir SEALED modu eklenir. Mod yalnız manifest SEALED iken devreye girer; trust root ve SHA256SUMS o anda yeniden doğrulanır, doğrulamadan geçmeyen FAIL olur. İmza artifact dışında (detached) kalır. Phase0=PENDING ve SOURCE_LEVEL_CLOSURE=false zorunlu kalır. paste4c ve belgeler PASS demeyen release-candidate değerleri alır (SEALED_RELEASE_CANDIDATE, EXTERNAL_DETACHED_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED). Mühürlü durum review edilmiş bir commit olur ve ZIP tam o commit'ten üretilir. Adversarial testler eklenir, Codex review otomatik yapılır. [Mekanik kapanış] validate-mechanical-closure.mjs'teki tek metin ('FINAL_TRUST_ROOT_SEAL = STALE_PENDING_FINAL_RESEAL') paste4c ile aynı biçimde manifestin sealStatus alanından türetilir (mühür öncesi STALE_PENDING_FINAL_RESEAL, SEALED iken SEALED_RELEASE_CANDIDATE); dosyadaki diğer kontroller aynen kalır; validate-paste2-closure.mjs'in yalnız çıktıya yazdığı değer P3 backlog olarak kayda alınır ve değiştirilmez.

[V6-PKG-R1-RELEASE-MODE-AND-PACKAGING-TOOLS-2026-09-28 founderAuthorization.constraint] Minimum changes only; no weakening of trust, authority, reviewer isolation, evidence, provenance, Global Stop, security or fail-closed behavior; UNKNOWN, NOT_TESTED, BLOCKED or FAIL are never converted to PASS/CLEAN without real evidence; broader protected changes require separate Founder approval.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical validation (config/validation.json) passes on the exact reviewed commit on Windows with Node >=24 and npm >=11, and the checkpoint records the measured validation environment.

The seal mode is derived only from config/trust-root-manifest.json sealStatus; with STALE_PENDING_FINAL_RESEAL every previous paste4d, paste4c and mechanical-closure rule still applies unchanged, and an unknown sealStatus fails.

In SEALED mode paste4d re-verifies the trust root in-process, accepts runtime TRUST_ROOT_VERIFY or ARTIFACT_VERIFY PASS reports only when the in-process verification (and, for ARTIFACT_VERIFY, the SHA256SUMS binding) passes, binds a present SHA256SUMS.txt to the sealed manifest hash, every trust-root hash and the lockfile, forbids any release signature file inside the tree, and requires release-candidate values that never state PASS while SOURCE_LEVEL_CLOSURE stays false and TARGET_MACHINE_PHASE0 stays PENDING.

release-sha256sums.mjs, build-release-zip.mjs and verify-release-extract.mjs fail closed on unclean or unsealed exports, SHA256SUMS mismatch, unsafe or duplicate paths, ZIP entries outside SHA256SUMS and non-fresh extract directories; the ZIP is deterministic; the unchanged verify-artifact.ps1/.mjs and verify-trust-root.mjs run inside the fresh extract.
The three new scripts are protected by exact path, automation/lib/release-artifact.mjs is protected by the existing automation/lib/ prefix, and no script creates, stores or uses a signing key.

Only the Founder-authorized protected files change, no existing test assertion, validator or policy is weakened beyond the authorized rule, and the trust-root manifest is not regenerated in this package.
mandatoryFailureCases: SHA256SUMS present in pre-seal mode
stale runtime PASS reports in pre-seal mode
unknown seal status
SEALED manifest with a tampered protected file
SEALED mode with PASS release authenticity or pre-seal document values
release signature file inside the tree
SHA256SUMS not bound to the sealed manifest or trust-root hashes
tampered export before packaging
ZIP entry not listed in SHA256SUMS
zip-slip or duplicate entry names
